question: Which ATT&CK techniques does CAPEC-555 (Remote Services with Stolen Credentials) map to, and what mitigations apply to those techniques?

answer.headline: Gathered 4 record(s) from 2 source(s); 3 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-555 maps to the ATT&CK techniques T1021 (Remote Services), T1114.002 (Remote Email Collection), and T1133 (External Remote Services). Mitigations for T1133 include M1035, M1021, M1030, M1032, and M1042. T1021 is associated with mitigations M1042, M1047, M1032, M1018, M1027, and M1035, while T1114.002 is associated with M1041, M1032, and M1060.

records.name: Remote Services with Stolen Credentials
records.label: AttackPattern
records.description: This pattern of attack involves an adversary that uses stolen credentials to leverage remote services such as RDP, telnet, SSH, and VNC to log into a system. Once access is gained, any number of malicious activities could be performed.

results.sub_question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for those mapped techniques?
results.query: MATCH (t) WHERE (t:Technique OR t:SubTechnique) AND t.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:MITIGATES]-(m:Mitigation) RETURN t.attack_id AS technique_id, t.name AS technique_name, m.attack_id AS mitigation_id, m.name AS mitigation_name LIMIT 300
